## Important limitations
This is a workflow guard, not a process sandbox. A plugin runs in the host process and has the host'
s permissions. The first version provides policy, evidence, and best-effort file snapshots; it does
not promise atomic rollback of arbitrary shell side effects, network operations, databases, or files
that were not included in a checkpoint.
For production use, review the source, pin the plugin version or commit, keep `.dsh-safe-workflow` o
